description: This file defines the IGrainFactory interface in the Orleans framework, providing methods for creating and managing references to grains, including getting grains by various key types, creating object references, and deleting references.

methods.name: GetGrain
methods.description: Retrieves a grain reference based on various key types and optional class name prefix.

methods.name: CreateObjectReference
methods.description: Creates a reference to a grain observer object.

methods.name: DeleteObjectReference
methods.description: Deletes a grain observer object reference.

methods.name: GetGrain
methods.description: Retrieves a grain reference based on grain type and primary key.

methods.name: GetGrain
methods.description: Retrieves a grain reference based on GrainId, with optional interface type.
